title: The lost property office
about: A railway station's lost property office. Its queries say what's there, its commands hand things in and claim them, and two workers act when nobody is waiting: one when something is handed in, and one on a schedule.
Each page offers links to what you can do next, but only the ones that would work for you now. And a claim that fails says what you can do instead.
storySoFar: Six things are waiting to be claimed, from a left glove to a set of false teeth (upper only). The roller skate and the library book have waited three months, so the next charity collection takes them.
Yesterday the traveller reported losing a black umbrella with a duck's head handle. Nobody has handed one in.
tryThis: As the clerk, hand in an umbrella found at any station.

As the traveller, look at your lost reports: the office has noticed it may be yours, and offers a link to claim it. Open the link, change the reference, and follow it. Then claim it properly, and try claiming it again.
The charity collects early each morning: see what was donated to charity.

title: The theatre box office
about: A small theatre's box office, selling seats for the four performances of The Pirates of Penge. Each performance offers only the links that would work for you now, and every result that says no says what you can do instead.
storySoFar: Thursday has plenty of seats, and the theatregoer already has two tickets for it. Friday has two seats left. Saturday evening has plenty.
The Saturday matinee is sold out, though the box office is still holding back four house seats.
tryThis: As the theatregoer, look at the performances: the matinee offers no way to buy seats, only to join the returns queue. Join it.
Open Friday's link to buy seats, ask for 4, and see what the box office offers instead.
Switch to box office staff: you're offered cancelling each performance, which the theatregoer never was, and releasing the matinee's house seats. Release them.
As the theatregoer, look at your tickets: your place in the matinee's returns queue now has a link to buy seats.
Open the performances in two tabs. Buy the last seats for a performance in one, then follow the same link in the other.
